notes: Adds an `e2e` job through `check-browser.yml@v1` for the Playwright preview harness, which CI ran before adopting recipes.
Keeps the `release` job calling `release-changesets.yml@v1` after `check` and `e2e`, because the game releases versions and a changelog with Changesets.

`ras changesets check` is gone with no replacement: `changeset status` fails every pull request without a changeset, while the game requires changesets only for player-visible changes, and the release workflow's `changeset version` still rejects a malformed one.
The SpacetimeDB bindings check runs in `spacetime.yml` from the `spacetimedb` recipe rather than in this workflow.

Adopts only the module layout, the bindings check, and the guarded publish: the game is a plain Vite client, not TanStack Start, so it keeps its own connection, reconnect, and guest-token code in `src/net/` instead of `src/client/spacetime.tsx`, and has no server for `spacetimeOrigin.ts`, `/api/health`, or a Content Security Policy.

Keeps the module's tables, reducers, and tests (`test/reducers.test.ts` against `test/mock-server.ts`) instead of the placeholder `note` module and `spacetimedbModuleTestPlugin`, which the pinned SDK predates.
The HTTP helper lives at `scripts/spacetime.ts`, beside the publish script that is its only caller, because the game has no server code.
Bindings stay at `src/net/module_bindings`, where the client imports them; `pnpm spacetime:generate` and `just generate` write there.

The CLI stays pinned at 2.6.0, the version the committed bindings were generated with, and the `spacetimedb` package at 2.7.1; bump the CLI, the package, and the bindings together in a deliberate upgrade, after checking the production server's version.
The module's `package.json` keeps the name `@trogg/module`.

`deploy-module.yml` calls `spacetime.yml` on pushes to main that touch the module or `shared/`, because the client deploys through Cloudflare Workers Builds, which cannot call a workflow; the module therefore publishes beside the client deploy rather than before it.

Preview workflows keep `spacetime publish --delete-data=on-conflict -y` for per-branch databases, whose data is disposable, and use the local `setup-spacetime` action so the CLI version is pinned once.
`pnpm check` also runs `pnpm build`, and `pnpm typecheck` also checks the SpacetimeDB module with `tsc --noEmit -p spacetimedb`, so one command covers what CI ran before.

`tsconfig.json` keeps the `@trogg/shared` path alias, also includes `shared/` and `bin/`, and excludes `*.test.ts` and `test/`, which were never type-checked and use loose fixtures (over 200 errors in the reducer tests).

`vitest.config.ts` also runs `shared/` and `test/` tests and aliases `@trogg/shared` and `spacetimedb/server` (to `test/mock-server.ts`), so the reducer tests evaluate the real module outside SpacetimeDB's host.
Formatting and lint ignore the generated bindings in `src/net/module_bindings`, which the bindings check compares byte for byte.
`.oxlintrc.json` turns off `unicorn/no-useless-spread`, whose fix drops the spread from SpacetimeDB index iterators (`[...ctx.db.x.idx.filter(k)]`) and breaks `.length` and array methods on them.

`.oxlintrc.json` turns off `no-unnecessary-type-assertion`, `no-redundant-type-constituents`, and `prefer-array-find` in tests: tests sit outside a tsconfig, so type-aware rules see unresolved aliases and no `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, and the fake index `filter(key)` is not a predicate filter.
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` keeps `minimumReleaseAge: 0`, the game's deliberate choice to track SpacetimeDB and PostHog releases the day they ship, and `core-js: true` in `allowBuilds`.
`.gitignore` keeps the game's own list (pnpm-only lockfiles, Playwright output, `spacetime.local.json`), which covers the recipe's entries.
Keeps the Changesets scripts (`changeset`, `version-packages`, `release`) because the game releases with Changesets, and `test:e2e` for the Playwright preview harness.

`pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `packages` to the root alone, because pnpm 11 otherwise counts `spacetimedb/package.json` as a workspace project when verifying dependencies and reinstalls before every `pnpm exec` and `pnpm run`.
